parameters.query: UPDATE clickup.tasks SET onedrive_link = CASE WHEN $2 = 'onedrive' THEN $1 ELSE onedrive_link END, youtube_link = CASE WHEN $2 = 'youtube' THEN $1 ELSE youtube_link END, synced_at = now() WHERE id = $3;

SELECT list_name, status, count(*)::int AS cnt
FROM clickup.tasks
WHERE list_id = $1
GROUP BY list_name, status
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
SELECT id, onedrive_link, youtube_link FROM clickup.tasks WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO clickup.task_links
  (student_task_id, order_task_id, order_task_name, order_task_status, link_type, pvtc_year)
SELECT $1, x.order_task_id, x.order_task_name, x.order_task_status, x.link_type, x.pvtc_year
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb)
  AS x(order_task_id text, order_task_name text, order_task_status text, link_type text, pvtc_year int)
ON CONFLICT (student_task_id, order_task_id, link_type) DO UPDATE SET
  order_task_name = EXCLUDED.order_task_name,
  order_task_status = EXCLUDED.order_task_status,
  pvtc_year = EXCLUDED.pvtc_year,
  synced_at = now();
